divergences_classified_against.source: the tree this corpus is committed with

fasta: GRCh37 chromosome 21, the GRCh37-hgvs corpus's reference.fa.gz decompressed, passed to both engines on every run
input: variants.vcf: three hand-placed chromosome 21 records, the reference bases read from the FASTA, on ENST00000594486, a reverse-strand protein-coding transcript that carries a frameshift intron: a deletion of the last base of intron 1 as the transcript reads it, 47613089; an insertion of a copy of the first base of exon 2 between 47613089 and 47613090; and the same deletion written on the first base of exon 2, 47613088. The 3' shift carries the first two one and two bases into the coding sequence of exon 2 (HGVS_OFFSET -1 and -2), where Ensembl VEP writes an HGVSp beside the shifted HGVSc; the third is exonic as written
generator: candidate records annotated with Ensembl VEP under the corpus flags (the container command above), then tools/vep-golden-corpus select --release 116 --assembly GRCh37 --dataset shift=<reference>=<input> --k 100 --seed 1 --covers hgvs --covers hgvs-offset-field --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv --flag=--hgvs --fasta-name ../GRCh37-hgvs/reference.fa.gz --out tests/golden/116/GRCh37-hgvs-intron-shift; tools/vep-storable-to-json <cache> <json> 21; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116; scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus tests/golden/116/GRCh37-hgvs-intron-shift --perl-cache-dir <cache root>; vep-golden-corpus classify --field HGVSc --field HGVSp --field HGVS_OFFSET --flag=--hgvs
